name: RCCL PR 2187: Force Simple protocol for gfx12 single-node collectives to fix deadlock
notes: Names the regression commit and the unfixed primitive: prims_ll.h never received the gfx12 memory-ordering fixes that prims_simple.h got, so selecting LL on gfx1201 deadlocks. Fixes a vLLM TP=2 inference deadlock on dual R9700.
